title: oenothera hookeri subsp. venusta
intro: Oenothera hookeri subsp. venusta, commonly known as Evening Primrose, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Onagraceae. The plant is prized for its seeds, which contain a rich oil rich in gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), an omega-6 fatty acid that has been linked to various health benefits, including reduced inflammation, improved skin health, and relief from symptoms of premenstrual syndrome (PMS). The therapeutic actions of Evening Primrose oil include its potential to reduce pain, improve cardiovascular health, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Evening Primrose include GLA, linoleic acid, and other polyunsaturated fatty acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
